description_en: Adds a data center to a cluster by calling CreateDataCenter
description_zh: 调用CreateDataCenter为集群添加数据中心
kebab_example: aliyun cassandra create-data-center --pay-type Subscription --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --cluster-id cds-bp113rmn00002uy9 --instance-type cassandra.c.large --node-count 2 --vpc-id vpc-bp1oxxxxxxxxxxgzv26cf --vswitch-id vsw-oqscxxxxxxxxxxxxx5e8c --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDataCenter

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: subscription.
PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

Pay-as-you-go instances do not have an expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型：

Subscription：包年包月
PayAsYouGo：按量付费

按量付费实例无到期时间
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Year: year.
Month: month.

This parameter is required if PayType is set to Subscription
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：

Year：包年；
Month：包月。

若付费类型为Subscription则该参数必须传入
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. This parameter is required if PayType is set to Subscription. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36.

This parameter is not supported if PayType is set to PayAsYouGo
parameters.help_zh:
付费周期，PayType（付费类型）为Subscription时为必选参数，单位为月，可选值：1-9，12，24，36 。

付费类型为PayAsYouGo时不支持传入此参数
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: enables auto-renewal.
false: does not enable auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，可选值：

true（开启）
false（不开启）

默认值：false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal epoch. Unit: months. Valid values:

1
2
3
6
12

This parameter is required if AutoRenew is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，可选值：

1
2
3
6
12

当AutoRenew为true时该参数必选
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query available zones. Use this parameter to specify the zone in which to create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID，可调用DescribeRegions查询，使用此参数指定要创建实例的可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the data center
parameters.name: data_center_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the cluster. Example valid values:

cassandra.c.large: 2 vCPUs, 4 GB memory.
cassandra.c.xlarge: 4 vCPUs, 8 GB memory.
cassandra.c.2xlarge: 8 vCPUs, 16 GB memory
parameters.help_zh:
集群实例类型。可取值部分示例：

cassandra.c.large：2核 4
Gcassandra.c.xlarge：4核 8G
cassandra.c.2xlarge：8核 16G
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the cloud disk. Example valid values:

cloud_ssd: standard SSD.
cloud_essd: Enterprise SSD (ESSD).
cloud_efficiency: ultra cloud disk.
local_ssd_pro: local SSD
parameters.help_zh:
磁盘存储类型。可取值示例：

cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD云盘
cloud_efficiency：高效云盘
local_ssd_pro：本地SSD盘
parameters.name: disk_type

parameters.help_en: The storage size per node. Unit: GB
parameters.help_zh: 磁盘存储大小（每节点，单位GB）
parameters.name: disk_size

DataCenterId.description_en: The ID of the data center in the cluster
